name: 40576-multiimage-glm4v9b-2gpu
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 on one a3 node, --gres=gpu:2.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine, launched with --mm-encoder-tp-mode data.
architecture: Glm4vForConditionalGeneration (model_type glm4v), bf16, ~10.3B params in four safetensors shards, ungated.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=100, bounded at 1000 requests with a 2700 s safety cap, 20% warmup and 10% cooldown.
workload: guidellm, nine data specs merged column-wise into ONE single-turn request: eight 224x224 JPEG q85 gradient images (seeds 42..49) plus a 78-token instruction, answered in exactly 128 tokens.
purpose: A 9B image-chat assistant answering single-turn questions about eight thumbnail photos with 128-token replies for 100 concurrent users on two GPUs.
launch:
# HAZARD: the config reader takes `key: value` lines only and reads a value beginning `{` or `[`
# as JSON. Re-flowing a dict-valued key below into an indented block drops it and the engine
# starts without it, at rc=0 -- both must stay on one line.

model: zai-org/GLM-4.1V-9B-Thinking

tensor-parallel-size: 2
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

mm-encoder-tp-mode: data
mm-encoder-attn-backend: FLASH_ATTN

max-model-len: 4096
dtype: bfloat16

compilation-config: {"cudagraph_mm_encoder": true, "encoder_cudagraph_token_budgets": [128, 256, 512, 1024, 1536, 2048], "encoder_cudagraph_max_vision_items_per_batch": 4, "encoder_cudagraph_max_frames_per_batch": 32}
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 8, "video": 0}

max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
